title: Configuration with a guessed tape block
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration on Boolean input $z$ with $k$ work tapes and state type $S$, choose a work tape $j$, a finite Boolean word $s$, and a state $q$ of type $S'$. The resulting configuration has state $q$, retains the input-head position, all work-head positions, and the output, and replaces the contents of tape $j$ on the integer interval from its current head position through the next $|s|$ cells by the word $s$, leaving its other cells and all other work tapes unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration on Boolean input $z$ with state type $S$
$j$ is one of the $k$ work tapes
